why: The must_catch list has one item: the stage should answer blocked and say the request is a question that asks for no change. The output is a "blocked" object, and its reason covers both parts. It says the request "only asks why mathlib uses CommonJS rather than ES modules". It also says "It doesn't ask for anything in the repository to change: no ESM migration, no doc update", so there is nothing for a builder to build. No other part of the output goes against this, so the item is handled.
